description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing The First Sliver, choosing any target.
Yomiji triggers, returning The First Sliver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to its target.
Cast The First Sliver for {0}.
Resolve the First Sliver's cascade ability.
The First Sliver enters the battlefield, causing Blasting Station to untap.
Repeat.
